CLAUDE.md — enderecobr

Source: CLAUDE.md

Project: enderecobr — R package that standardizes Brazilian addresses (street names, neighborhoods, municipalities, states, CEP/postal codes) using string-manipulation rules (no fuzzy/probabilistic matching), built on the Rust crate enderecobr_rs via extendr Maintainers: Daniel Herszenhut (aut, cre), Rafael H. M. Pereira (aut — Ipea), Lucas Mation (aut), Gabriel Garcia de Almeida (aut) — Instituto de Pesquisa Econômica Aplicada (IPEA) Repo: https://github.com/ipea/enderecobr (org migrated to ipea/enderecobr — old URL redirects; git remote still points at ipea, harmless but worth updating eventually) · Branch: main Language: Language: pt in DESCRIPTION — NEWS.md, roxygen docs, README, and most code comments are in Portuguese; match that for user-facing content

Core Principles

  • Plan first — enter plan mode before non-trivial tasks; save plans to quality_reports/plans/
  • R/ is authoritative — man/ and NAMESPACE are generated by roxygen2. Never hand-edit; edit the roxygen blocks in R/ and run devtools::document()
  • Two backends, one release gate. R CMD check --as-cran (0 errors, 0 warnings, every note justified in cran-comments.md) gates the R side. A clean cargo build of src/rust/ against the pinned enderecobr_rs version gates the Rust side — both must pass before merge or release.
  • enderecobr_rs is upstream, not vendored source. The actual standardization logic lives in the sibling repo ipea/enderecobr_rs (published on crates.io). src/rust/ here is a thin extendr wrapper crate around it. A reported bug is usually fixed there first — pulling the fix into this package means bumping the version pin in src/rust/Cargo.toml, not patching logic here. See r-extendr-conventions.md (global rule).
  • [LEARN] tags — when corrected, or a non-obvious approach is confirmed, append [LEARN:category] wrong → right to MEMORY.md

Cross-session context lives in MEMORY.md; plans, specs, and session logs are in quality_reports/. Workflow rules, skills, and agents are configured globally at ~/.claude (shared with flightsbr / geobr / geobr-r-package) and apply here via path-scoping — see “Skills Quick Reference” below for what’s actually live in this repo.

Folder Structure

enderecobr/
├── CLAUDE.md                    # This file
├── DESCRIPTION / NAMESPACE      # Package metadata / generated exports (never hand-edit NAMESPACE)
├── NEWS.md                      # User-facing changelog, in Portuguese (bump per release)
├── cran-comments.md             # CRAN submission notes (NOTE justifications go here)
├── configure / configure.win    # Generate src/Makevars(.win) from tools/config.R — don't hand-edit output
├── tools/                       # config.R (build config), msrv.R (Rust version check)
├── R/                           # Package source — padronizar_*() functions + extendr-wrappers.R (GENERATED)
├── src/
│   ├── entrypoint.c             # C→Rust init forwarding
│   └── rust/                    # extendr wrapper crate (Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs)
│       ├── Cargo.toml           # pins `enderecobr_rs` — the actual dependency to bump for upstream fixes
│       └── vendor.tar.xz        # vendored crates.io deps for CRAN offline builds — regenerate via `cargo vendor`
├── data-raw/                    # Builds codigos_estados / codigos_municipios reference tables
├── tests/testthat/              # testthat (edition 3), incl. _snaps/ for error/warning message text
├── man/                         # GENERATED .Rd docs — edit roxygen in R/ instead
├── vignettes/                   # enderecobr.Rmd
├── pkgdown/                     # pkgdown site config
├── .github/workflows/           # check.yaml (multi-platform incl. Windows ARM64), pkgdown.yaml, test-coverage.yaml, rhub.yaml
├── quality_reports/             # Plans, specs, session logs, merge reports, archive
└── templates/                   # session-log / requirements-spec / quality-report templates

Commands

# Regenerate docs + NAMESPACE after editing roxygen blocks in R/
devtools::document()

# Run the test suite (includes Rust-backed functions + message/error snapshots)
devtools::test()

# Full CRAN-readiness check (slow — background + monitor for long runs)
devtools::check(args = "--as-cran")

# Test coverage
covr::package_coverage()
# Bump the enderecobr_rs dependency to pull in an upstream fix/feature
cd src/rust && cargo update -p enderecobr_rs --precise X.Y.Z

# Regenerate R/extendr-wrappers.R — ONLY needed if the extendr-exposed function
# signatures changed upstream (not for internal-only fixes)
Rscript -e "rextendr::document()"

# Local R CMD check equivalent to CI
R CMD build . && R CMD check --as-cran enderecobr_*.tar.gz

CRAN submission: update NEWS.md + bump Version in DESCRIPTION, refresh cran-comments.md, regenerate src/rust/vendor.tar.xz if Cargo.lock changed, then devtools::release() (maintainer-only, not automated).

Quality Gate

Check Bar
R CMD check --as-cran 0 errors, 0 warnings, every NOTE explained in cran-comments.md
cargo build (src/rust/) Compiles clean against the pinned enderecobr_rs version
devtools::test() All tests pass; every exported function has at least one test
CI matrix Windows (incl. ARM64), macOS, Ubuntu (devel/release/oldrel) all green — see .github/workflows/check.yaml
roxygen docs Every exported function: @param (all args), @return, runnable @examples

Full standard: r-package-conventions.md (R side) + r-extendr-conventions.md (Rust/build side, both global, path-scoped).

Note on /commit: the global /commit skill’s Step 0 (scripts/quality_score.py) and Step 0b (scripts/check-surface-sync.sh) are built for the original Beamer/Quarto template project — neither script exists here. Skip Step 0/0b for enderecobr; the real gate is R CMD check --as-cran + a clean Rust build, run before merging. Steps 1–7 (branch, stage, commit, PR, merge) still apply normally.

Package Functions

Function Purpose
padronizar_enderecos() Flagship function — standardizes multiple address fields of a dataframe at once, given a field↔︎column mapping (built via correspondencia_campos())
padronizar_logradouros_completos() Standardizes + combines street-type, street-name, and number into one “logradouro completo” field
padronizar_logradouros() Standardizes street names (abbreviation expansion, diacritics/casing)
padronizar_tipos_de_logradouro() Standardizes street-type prefixes (e.g. “r” → “RUA”)
padronizar_numeros() Standardizes house/building numbers (S/N variants, leading zeros, format)
padronizar_complementos() Standardizes address complement fields (e.g. “qd 20” → “QUADRA 20”)
padronizar_ceps() Standardizes CEP (postal code) to NNNNN-NNN, validates digit count
padronizar_bairros() Standardizes neighborhood names
padronizar_municipios() Standardizes municipality names/codes via codigos_municipios
padronizar_estados() Standardizes state names/codes/abbreviations

All R-level functions follow the same pattern: checkmate input validation → call the *_rs() extendr wrapper → cli/rlang-based structured errors (erro_endbr) / warnings (warning_endbr). Follow this pattern for any new function.

Rust / extendr Notes

  • Config/rextendr/version: 0.4.2 in DESCRIPTION — this is a rextendr-scaffolded package.
  • SystemRequirements: Cargo, rustc >= 1.65 (DESCRIPTION) / rust-version = "1.81" (src/rust/Cargo.toml — the tighter constraint wins), xz.
  • tools/msrv.R checks the installed Rust toolchain meets the minimum; tools/config.R (invoked by configure/configure.win) resolves CRAN-vs-dev build flags and Windows target triples (incl. aarch64-pc-windows-gnullvm for ARM64) before rendering src/Makevars(.win) from the .in templates.
  • src/rust/vendor.tar.xz + vendor-config.toml: vendored crates.io deps (including enderecobr_rs itself) for CRAN’s offline build requirement. Regenerate with cargo vendor whenever Cargo.lock changes and before a CRAN submission — stale vendor tarballs break offline builds silently.
  • Full conventions: r-extendr-conventions.md (global rule, path-scoped to src/rust/**, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, configure*, tools/*.R) — not yet created; see the pending workflow-adaptation plan.

Data Source Notes

  • codigos_estados / codigos_municipios (exported reference datasets, IBGE 2022 codes) are built by data-raw/extracao_tabelas_de_codigos.R — rerun and re-export (usethis::use_data()) if IBGE codes change, don’t hand-edit R/sysdata.rda.
  • Record enderecobr-specific quirks (Rust/R boundary gotchas, CRAN vendoring issues, enderecobr_rs API changes) as [LEARN:enderecobr] entries in MEMORY.md as they’re discovered.
